_comment: Token prices per 1,000,000 tokens, in USD. Every value ships as null ON PURPOSE: src/pricing.py returns None rather than guessing, because a fabricated price gets averaged and believed. Fill these from the provider's own dashboard (platform.moonshot.ai for Kimi) and re-check them periodically -- published prices change, and a hardcoded one rots silently. A model missing from this table is simply unpriced; nothing breaks.
